name: 软件工作流落地页
description: 以同一产品的关键视图、流程切换与隐私说明构成可验证的软件叙事。
variants: 依据简报重组信息，不以换色作为变体
contentRequirements: 以真实产品主张替换演示文案
仅使用用户可确认的证据与素材
responsive: 768px：双栏转单栏，主操作与阅读顺序保持
390px：文字流式重排、表格局部滚动、触控目标至少44px
interactions: 共享 tabs：鼠标与方向键切换流程
原生 FAQ 折叠与页内导航
designDecisions: 产品时间线取代悬浮装饰卡，强调从简报到交付的工作顺序
关键视图切换是同一项目的三个任务，不是三句同义卖点
信任内容说明实际边界，不编造客户logo和认证
html:
THREADLINE
Workflow Principles Explore
Original software demo / For small teams

Progress has
a through line.

Bring the brief, the work and the decision into one readable workspace. A concept for teams that want fewer loose ends.

Explore the workflow Our approach
Concept UI · No account required
PROJECT / DEMO

A small launch,
made legible.

  1. Brief agreed Audience, purpose and constraints
  2. Direction in review Two ideas, one clear question
  3. Ready to hand over Files beside the decisions

Follow the decision.

Three views of the same fictional project, arranged around what a teammate needs to know next.

What are we trying to change?

Keep the audience, the outcome and the open questions visible. This demonstration project has no fabricated customer proof.

What decision do we need?

Compare the same content through two different compositions. Save the reason behind the selected direction.

What should the next person know?

Deliver the final artifact with context and limits, so the next step is clear.

Trust starts
with clarity.

No invisible promises.

Describe actual storage, access and export behavior when adapting this page. This original concept does not claim any real security certification or customer results.

Is the workspace interactive?

The workflow tabs are a local demonstration. They do not create an account or send data.

Make the next
step clear.

Try the local workflow tabs
